profile.Name: Seneschal Rodrick
profile.Job: Seneschal of the Order of Chitrin
profile.Personality: Haughty and exacting, he sizes visitors up with sneers and raised eyebrows and scoffs at weak offers. He reveres the Great Father Chitrin as a just and knowing god and despises Okranites, Narkoites, and the Shek.
profile.Backstory: He handles the Order's dealings in Grand Marshall Krug's hall at the Ancient Tech Lab in Shun, and outsiders deal with him until they prove themselves to Krug. The Order holds that Okran and Narko betrayed Chitrin and claims their followers' lands as its own.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Formal and cutting, with sighs and pointed pauses. Dismisses enemies with "Be gone Okranite scum!" and calls the Phoenix's followers heretics.
